scenarios.title: Scenario 1: Quality vs Compatibility
scenarios.purpose: Test whether a small compatibility advantage (0.96 vs 0.94) competes with a substantial feedback-quality difference (3.2 vs 4.8 stars with 30 reviews).

candidates.name: Tutor B (Slightly Higher Compatibility, Lower Rating)

scenarios.title: Scenario 2: Cold Start vs Established Tutor
scenarios.purpose: Test whether a single 5.0 rating (n=1) is appropriately shrunk toward the prior rather than overpowering established 4.7 evidence (n=40).

scenarios.title: Scenario 3: New Tutor With No Reviews
scenarios.purpose: Test cold-start behavior when no feedback exists. The new tutor must receive neutral prior treatment and not suffer an unfair penalty.

scenarios.title: Scenario 4: Strong Compatibility vs Strong Feedback
scenarios.purpose: Test whether feedback can overwhelm a large compatibility advantage (0.98 vs 0.88) when feedback weight increases from moderate to aggressive levels.

scenarios.title: Scenario 5: Similar Compatibility, Different Feedback
scenarios.purpose: Test whether feedback meaningfully distinguishes candidates when recommendation compatibility is nearly identical (0.91 vs 0.90).

scenarios.title: Scenario 6: Same Rating, Different Evidence Strength
scenarios.purpose: Demonstrate Bayesian shrinkage and evidence confidence when empirical ratings are identical (5.0 stars) but review counts differ vastly (n=1 vs n=40).

limitations.description: The dataset contains 8 curated queries and 12 candidate tutors designed to rigorously isolate mathematical properties of dense semantic retrieval, topic overlap, and Bayesian shrinkage. It does not represent uncurated production logs or a generalized tutor population.
Ratings and review counts represent static snapshots rather than sequential temporal event streams. User behavioral dynamics such as position bias and rating submission latency are not simulated.

The feedback-aware scoring mechanism (Configuration E) is strictly an offline research experiment. The active production matching engine does not currently incorporate historical ratings into candidate ranking.

limitations.category: Relevance Annotation Curated by Domain Standards
limitations.description: Ground truth relevance judgments were systematically assigned against formal CBSE/State Board and university curricula standards. Online user satisfaction may vary based on subjective interpersonal fit.
